item.title: Jana's Expressions
item.description:
🤖 This page was translated from Dutch with AI. Read the original in Dutch. The expressions themselves are Dutch and are kept in Dutch.

The expression “beminnelijke deugd der inschikkelijkheid” (roughly “the lovable virtue of accommodation”) sounds very old-fashioned and formal. Here is what it means in normal, modern language:

📘 Meaning

  • Beminnelijke deugd → an attractive, likeable quality
  • Inschikkelijkheid → being accommodating, flexible, willing to adapt to others

👉 In short

“De beminnelijke deugd der inschikkelijkheid” means: the lovely, likeable quality of someone who easily goes along with others and doesn’t make things difficult.
